title: Successor-field configuration update
statement: Given a natural number $m$, a Boolean input string, source and destination work-tape indices, a Boolean choice $c$, an initial configuration $d$, a Boolean string $w$, a natural number $r$, and a successor-processing phase $q$, define a new configuration with the same input-head position and output as $d$ and state $q$. If $c$ is true, replace the destination tape's cells in the interval from its old head position (inclusive) to that position plus $r$ (exclusive) by the corresponding symbols of $w$, interpreting positions in $w$ beyond its length as blank; leave every other work-tape cell unchanged. Advance the source head by $r$, and also advance the destination head by $r$ exactly when $c$ is true and the destination and source indices coincide; leave all other work-head positions unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $m$ of work tapes
